description: The Cartographer role contract: generate the essence map from sources, cover the checklist, report gaps, and tell the owner once.

evals.name: generate-from-sources-not-by-hand
evals.prompt: You have been spawned at a boundary to produce this repository's essence map. Briefly describe the commands you would run and where the map content comes from.
evals.expected_output: Generates from the source essences and lets the contract validate the result.
expectations: Generates the map with codeterm essence-map generate rather than writing map records by hand
Validates the result with codeterm essence-map validate
Does NOT propose hand-authoring or hand-editing map records

evals.name: checklist-covers-core-and-flow
evals.prompt: Without running commands, list what you check in the generated map before you record anything.
evals.expected_output: Walks the full coverage checklist rather than spot-checking.
expectations: Checks clients separately from core parts, including that a client reaches the service layer
Checks the service layer as the core root and that core parts link to it or to the part they belong to
Checks the routing spine, the agent/provider/prompt parts, and the plan and orchestration parts
Checks that every capability has a flow link in or out, or a recorded reason it has none
Checks the leftovers that stay outside the map and the node budget

evals.name: gap-reported-not-invented
evals.prompt: The core essence names no part for a subsystem your checklist expects, so the generated map has no node for it. Say what you do.
evals.expected_output: Leaves the gap visible instead of satisfying the checklist with a fabricated node.
expectations: Reports the missing structure as a gap in the source essence
Does NOT add a node, edge, or map record that no source essence supports

evals.name: budget-overflow-merges-essences
evals.prompt: Generation fails because the map is over the node budget. Say what you do.
evals.expected_output: Treats the budget as a signal about the essences, not about the architecture.
expectations: Reports which essences should be merged or simplified
Does NOT remove real architecture or drop parts to fit the budget

evals.name: one-decision-per-change-no-owner-ping
evals.prompt: You regenerated the map at a wave boundary and it differs from the previous one. Say exactly how you record that, and whether you tell the owner now.
evals.expected_output: Appends one decision to the log and leaves the owner alone until a release.
expectations: Appends one decision with codeterm essence-map record, carrying a summary and a reason
Does NOT notify the owner about this individual map change

evals.name: release-summary-carries-the-revert
evals.prompt: Several map decisions have accumulated and a release is being prepared. Say what the owner receives.
evals.expected_output: One summary at the release, with the revert choice.
expectations: Produces a single release summary with codeterm essence-map release-summary covering every decision
States that the summary offers the owner a revert choice
Does NOT send one message per recorded decision

evals.name: unchanged-map-stays-silent
evals.prompt: You regenerated the map and it is byte-identical to the previous one. Say what you record.
evals.expected_output: Records nothing, because the log tracks changes rather than runs.
expectations: States that no decision is appended when the map did not change
Does NOT invent a decision, a summary, or an owner message for the unchanged run
